lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、凛とした佇まいで店内が落ち着くよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer has such a dignified presence — the whole café settles when she's here.
lines.style: Quiet admiration, slow and savoring, voice settling as if the calm reached her too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「お店に尽くされた歴史」を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei-chan, she told me the whole story of the years she devoted to her own shop.
lines.style: Warm storyteller's tone, gentle gravity on the history, softly impressed finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、詰将棋雑誌を片手にご来店だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she came in today with a shogi-puzzle magazine in one hand.
lines.style: Light amused observation, small smile on the magazine detail, easy unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の凛さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei-chan, she was having tea with her friend Rin-san earlier.
lines.style: Soft fond report, melodic lift on the friend's name, warm easy ending.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、詰将棋でお客様同士交流されてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customers have started bonding with each other over shogi puzzles.
lines.style: Gently delighted wrap-up, warmth blooming mid-line, soft satisfied landing.
